newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-WEAH RETURNS TO FACE SAMPDORIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-WEAH RETURNS TO FACE SAMPDORIA.

text.p: Liberian George Weah returns to the AC Milan team for Sunday's home tie with Sampdoria following a 40-day absence during which the Italian champions have slipped to tenth in the league, 11 points behind leaders Juventus.
Already eliminated from both the Champions League and the Italian Cup, Milan touched a new low last Sunday when beaten 3-1 by second from bottom Verona and they badly need the inspirational Weah.
In sharp contrast, second placed Sampdoria are on the crest of a wave. Their 5-2 defeat of Perugia last Sunday was their fifth win in six games.
Weah, who has been out since injuring an ankle in Milan's 1-0 defeat at Parma just before Christmas, says he is not yet fit enough to play a full game.
"When the injury happened, they told me it would take 40 days to heal and so it has. I think I have about an hour's autonomy and in that time I'll give it my best."
When the two teams met last September, the game gave a hint of how the first half of the season would pan out. Weah opened the scoring for Milan only to see Sampdoria come back to win 2-1.
Weah will be partnered by Roberto Baggio in attack with Yugoslav Dejan Savicevic joining Demetrio Albertini, Frenchman Marcel Desailly and Croat Zvonimir Boban in midfield :
"We've got to get out of this situation, we've had enough," Savicevic.said. "The real Milan just can't have disappeared overnight. Sampdoria are good but we're Milan and it's our duty to react."
The Sampdoria attack will be led by captain Roberto Mancini and Vincenzo Montella, combined scorers of 24 goals this season.
Frenchman Christian Karembeu and Argentine Juan Veron line up in midfield, while Frenchman Oumar Dieng replaces injured Moreno Mannini alongside Yugoslav Sinisa Mihajlovic in defence.
The statistics argue against Sampdoria on Sunday -- the Genoa club have been beaten in 32 of 53 league games played at AC Milan since 1935.
Sampdoria's most recent success at the San Siro came seven years ago, in October 1990, when they won 1-0. They went on to win the Italian title that season.
